title: Cedar in a jar
logline: The garage's Christmas: a sprig of cedar in the fourth jar on the sill, water in it, the rain outside. No tree, no lights. The page's whole December in a jar the nib usually lives in.

panels.composition: A garage window sill in December rain with three jars and a fourth holding a sprig of cedar in water, the chewed nib handle set beside it on the sill.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a garage window sill in December rain with three jars and a fourth holding a sprig of cedar in water, a small chewed wooden pen handle set beside it, no words
image.notes: The nib's jar (ro_2023-01-08) borrowed for a month.
